notes.title: Patchnotes 2.3.112
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just released an update with several bug fixes and balancing changes. Here are the details:

Fixes 


 Fixed "Join by Game ID" that did not work for some server regions
 Fixed Warbanner and Minions when starting a new run
 (Co-op) Fixed host players who don't have any additional Zones unlocked sometimes load into the wrong Zone, even though the game should have already ended
 (Co-op) Fixed camera hiccup in the platforming challenge room, when a player with one health left gets hit (made the challenge quite impossible)
 Fixed missing translations


Balancing 


 Changed required drones to 3 to unlock the "Let them do the work" achievement
 Improved readability of item text when playing local co-op


Additional Changes 


 Added a continue notification if you press "Start Game" and then "Offline Game" that asks the player if they want to start a new game, or continue the previously saved one


Have fun playing!

Lino & the Rarebyte Team

notes.title: Patchnotes 2.2.108
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just released a small update with several bug fixes and balancing changes. Here's the details:

Fixes 

 (Co-op) Fixed win streaks only increasing for a client player, if the client is currently on the same win streak 
 (Co-op) Fixed TNT not working 
 Fixed store not offering reduced cost after picking up the StoreSale item 
 Fixed the item from the Fortune Wheel sometimes dropping again afterwards 
 Fixed missing Fortune Wheel sound effects 
 Fixed player shots sometime getting invisible if they became too big 
 Fixed missing position indicator arrow with "Snag Mutated" 
 Added new particles to indicate the dragon boss' position in the lava 
 Fixed player taking damage if touching a wall with lava next to it 
 Fixed player model sometimes got off-centered after winning the game and restarting 
 Fixed an issue if the host player becomes inactive (not disconnected), a new host is automatically selected 
 Fixed item FriendlyFly, it now shoots triple shots at level 10 instead of two very weak shots 
 Fixed character Nibble no longer resets when dying with any other character 
 Fixed player getting stuck inside of level geometry 


Balancing 

 Item UnrealStrike: increased travel speed and damage 
 Item DamageBoost: shots also pierce its target, duration increased from 6 to 10 seconds 
 Item WhimsicalStar: damage reduced by 20% 
 Item ItemReroll: reduced cooldown from 6 to 3 rooms 
 Character Baby: increased move speed from 18 to 19 
 Character Croc: increased damage and health 
 Character Quick: reduced max health from 5 to 4 and slightly reduced damage at Level 3 
 Character Bob: added SplashStomps at Level 3 
 Item Bomberman: changed cooldown from 4 kills to 5 seconds 
 Character Rarebyte: starts with the MinionCannon instead of the MinionPistol, this way chances are higher to get the synergy 
 Item MinionCannon: changed cooldown from 6 kills to 6 seconds 
 Item Minion Synergy: minions additionally fire at nearby enemies 
 Character Ryo: additional +1 bomb at level 3, +20% crit chance at level 3 
 Item FriendlyFly: damage at level 10 reduced from 25 to 20, it can no longer eat all 3 items in the choice/corrupt room 


Thank you for playing!

Lino & the Rarebyte team

notes.title: Patchnotes 2.0.107
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

The new update is here - with lots of bugfixes, some small additions, and balancing changes.

Here are the detailed patch notes:

Additions

 Massive performance improvements in later zones and/or when equipped with a lot of items
 "Continue" in the main menu is now automatically selected when continuing is possible
 (Co-op) Every player, instead of just the host player, increases their win streak, if they have Zone 6 unlocked locally
 Added "Reset to default" option to the controls menu


Fixes

 (Co-op) Fixed various problems that occurred when the host player switched in an online game (enemies did not die, or bosses spawned infinite Malbytes etc.)
 (Co-op) Fixed players not being able to jump for 1-2 seconds after using the portal, or if another player took damage
 (Co-op) Fixed broken Nibble character model for client players
 Fixed overly bright glitch particles on Chests with the "Glitch Chests" item
 Fixed duplicates of the "Retro Symbol" spawned, after using the Save & Quit feature
 Fixed "Stake Launcher" projectiles sometimes becoming extremely big, covering most of the screen
 Fixed Glitched Shopkeeper items still costing coins to pickup, when they should be free
 Fixed heart pickups not being displayed in the pickup animation for a split second
 Fixed leaving a room too quickly after opening a chest causing no item to spawn
 Fixed pressing "Collected Items" softlocking the game (if it still does not work for you, please let us know!)
 Fixed achievements being unlockable in the tutorial
 Fixed some Save & Quit bugs
 Fixed level portal spawning in very tight level geometry and causing players to not being able to enter/exit it
 Fixed "Magic Stick" item transforming RetroSymbol enemies, therefore making it impossible to get the RetroSymbol item
 Fixed custom seeds breaking the game
 Fixed sacrificing an item that gives max health not removing the max health
 Fixed getting multiple of the same rare item from the Item Transformator (only one rare per player should be possible here)
 Fixed RetroBoy sometimes spawning more enemies from his projectiles, where they got stuck in level geometry or even outside of it
 Fixed Malbytes from the RetroBoy sometimes spawning inside level geometry


Balancing

 "Super Jump Boots" item needs to be re-charged now by touching the ground or a wall, before it can be used again
 Buffed "Warbanner" item by increasing its range


Thank you all for playing!

Lino & the Rarebyte team

notes.title: New Content, DLC Sale, and QoL Improvements!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for Playing Rogue Glitch! I hope you've had a great time both offline, and online with friends. Today brings a new patch with a few bonus features and a number of quality of life improvements for all players. 

Paired with this update is a weeklong sale for the Online Mode DLC at 50% off. If you've been having a blast solo in Rogue Glitch, this will be a great time to buddy up for half the price!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35485815/2def42ca595b8dd941e9db65bf88993cd6620b1a.gif

New Additions:
- "Nibble", a new Character with randomized stats!
- Modifiers, including "Seeded Runs", "Random Enemies" and "Glitches Only". (Accessible when all Items are unlocked!)
- Save and Continue between Zones
- Skip final Zone Malfecto dialogue in Offline Play

Fixes and Changes:
- The Corrupt Trader will reward more Items when exchanging 6 or more corrupt Pickups
- The Health Eater takes two hearts a lot less frequently
- Shopkeeper has more HP in later zones
- Fixed Skins on "Luna" not appearing properly
- Fixed Pickups and Items dropping in unreachable areas
- Fixed "MagicStick" Item to prevent transforming enemies in unreachable areas
- Fixed "Bat" spawning in unreachable areas
- Fixed floating point errors on stat changes
- Fixed "Stake Launcher" canceling out "Piercing Shots"
- "Skull Deal" will take 30 Coins or 2 Items if the player doesn't have enough Coins
- Zone 6 Levels tweaks
- Zone 4 difficulty adjusted
- In "Offline Mode" the game will not spawn your character's rare starting Items
- Reworked Jump Synergy Item
- "ExtraJump" Items are a lot more common now

Best of luck in the Glitchworld!

-Lino

notes.title: Rogue Glitch Full Launch and Free-2-Play Update!
notes.content:
Rogue Glitch is entering its next form with a full launch today!

Before talking about the new patch, I would like to thank all the people who joined me in Rogue Glitch during the Early Access. Your support during these early days was a huge help, especially all the feedback provided here and on the Discord channel. Life as a solo developer has never felt so connected as it does now. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35485815/47efdb3e6e0c776fe85bc45f9f003e95dc00b93b.gif

Free 2 Play Singleplayer (+Local Co-op)
One of the biggest changes arriving with today's launch is that the Singleplayer mode is going Free 2 Play. I've been working on this game for a couple years now and I'd like to give everyone the opportunity to try it. The multiplayer functionality will now be available as a DLC extra for those who have enjoyed their experience and want to share it with friends online. 

Of course all current owners of Rogue Glitch from the Early Access period will retain multiplayer functionality. It should automatically be enabled for you but let me know if you have any problems.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35485815/529277fefc29884baf94f2968fd930feee2c26a7.gif

New Content
The latest patch has also come online bringing new content:
-The final Glitchworld "The Creator's Domain" where you'll meet Malfecto, God of Glitches for the last time... Or is it?
-13 new item unlocks (Missile Boots, Explosive Pooper, Health Shield, Multithreading)
-QOL tweaks including more forgiving stomps and balance changes to zone 4
-Win Streaks for beating the game with increased difficulty each time (up to 5)

And 2 New Characters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35485815/105768d43b716d646e7cf89eea66cb322ba23365.gif

Meet Glitch Pixel rewarded for the first 6-zone completion of the game. Starting the game with just 1-HP, Glitch Pixel is a glass cannon with +50% increase DMG and Firerate. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35485815/099556a7e4fafc28ec2572ff120a2036fcaf9089.gif

Meet Luna! To find out how to unlock this little chum, head over to the Rogue Glitch Discord. 

I hope you all very much enjoy your time in Rogue Glitch's launch build. I will still be watching for your feedback so please share your suggestions and findings. 

Goodluck in the Glitchworld - You'll need it! <3

-Lino

notes.title: Twitch & Discord Integration for Rogue Glitch!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Rogue Glitch is receiving an exciting update today to bring Twitch streaming integration with a load of functionality for viewers to influence a streamers game. The audience will be able to help out by spawning cooperative drones and selecting powerful items in chests, or plot the demise of the player by placing special enemies in the rooms ahead.

Getting Set Up!
If you’d like to introduce Rogue Glitch’s Twitch Integration to your stream, it’s super easy! When you first launch Rogue Glitch from Steam, select the "RogueGlitch Twitch Mod" launch option. After pressing start game, simply paste your channel URL into the Twitch field and push connect. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35485815/5c87dab26f1e8d6266e0c6b2d425c56101d2b3fd.jpg

How It Works
Rogue Glitch is now able to pick up certain commands from your chat channel. There is no intrusive code accessing the streamers local client - all information is read from the streams chat.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35485815/74244e2339239de185c55b82961c707687e7cf64.jpg

What Now?
Enjoy! Jump into a run as you usually would and Rogue Glitch will handle the rest. At intermittent points the game will present opportunities for viewers to vote! Currently they are able to pick upcoming special enemies and vote on the items the player will receive from chests. They can also show their support by donating bits which will equip the player with a random friendly drone to assist.  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35485815/b4d326126438097f950b7d41ce45b899d71ca5e4.jpg

Discord Functionality
Rogue Glitch now allows you to invite friends to your game via Discord. Additionally you can broadcast an invitation to the official Rogue Glitch Discord Server to find new people to play coop with if you want to make friends and overcome greater challenges.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35485815/7c7ff7a958961b6d381e388d6c3d0077fb2f5ac9.gif

If you have any questions about the system or suggestions for more ways the community can interact, please comment below!

As always I wish you a fantastic time in-game, and may the odds be ever in your favour!

-Lino

notes.title: ROGUE GLITCH - THE CORRUPT CONTENT UPDATE
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/QC1AtVO.gif

Greetings, glitchers!
Before I jump into what’s included in this update, I wanted to give a big thank you for playing Rogue Glitch. Your feedback and support has been exceptionally helpful in my journey in developing the game. 

In celebration of the update’s release, Rogue Glitch is 30% off for seven days ending on Friday the 24th! With a revamped game experience, additional content, music, and improvements to early progression, now is a great time to welcome new players and/or to bring a friend with you into the fray.

Let’s take a look at what’s new in the Corrupt Content Update!
https://i.imgur.com/1Qq3NHo.gif

New Content
The power of the glitch-world has brought in a fresh range of creations to bolster your arsenal and new foes to turn into pixel-dust! Make room for:
 
- 4 new Zones (2 reworked) to discover... 
- 3 new Bosses to defeat 
- 20 new Items to collect 
- 11 new Enemies to encounter 
- 2 new Characters to unlock 
- 5 new Special Rooms to find 
- 7 new Music tracks, + some ambience

- A new color option available in the game's settings 
- Numerous fixes, improvements, and QOL changes

https://i.imgur.com/IhzwfLc.gif

New weapons include a beam-bending laser, poison cloud augments and carpet-bombing cluster grenades. You’ll be pitted against tough new enemies like the warping Monster Worms (inspired by nightmares) and a rare abominable glitch boss. Pick up a master key for access to any chest you’d like and keep a close eye out for some of the new secret rooms.

https://i.imgur.com/6q96T74.gif

I’d like to introduce you to Bob, possibly the cutest of characters (Well, who can compare with Baby! Second cutest). He will generate an impenetrable shield while performing a downward stomp, adding defense to your offense!

A new option has been added to the game settings menu called “Simple Enemy Colours”. Turning this on will make all enemies the same colour to make identifying threats easier when things get a bit hectic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35485815/1d511cd7bb2796ce50aa7d61947013328c08d242.jpg

Changes
The “completion” system has been reworked to bring tangible progression to new players at the beginning of the game. You will start with just one world and completing it will start to unfold the mysterious forces behind Rogue Glitch (#NoSpoilers). With each completion, a new world will be added to increase the challenge of getting to the end and advancing your adventure. This will continue increasing until your runs become five worlds long per completion. 

This shift in the world means savedata is being reset, however if you had previously unlocked items you will receive double XP!

In addition, I have made balancing tweaks to existing characters, items, enemies, and overall difficulty in some areas. 

Music
Failpositive has brought even more upbeat electronic energy to the Corrupt Content Update with 7 new vibrant tracks, and many special rooms are now outfitted with ambience. All of these wonderful new tunes are now available to listen to on Bandcamp, SoundCloud, and YouTube! Here is one of them we’re featuring here: 

https://soundcloud.com/failpositive/exponential-growth

Psst, there’s also a new sweet-sounding secret character hiding behind the scenes… Look carefully you might find him!

I hope you enjoy all the new content with your friends (from the safety of your home!)

Best, 
Lino

notes.title: Rogue Glitch Update 1 - New Challenges, Items, New Character, Tweaks and AMA! (v0.102)
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has ventured into Rogue Glitch in these early and exciting times! Over the weekend I’ve built the beginning of the challenge system and Steam achievements. Each of these challenges offer a new item for your pool as a reward and the “Untouchable” challenge will grant you access to the latest playable character, Igor.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35485815/1712c6e112909a7d216e9ba54cfe1ff005ec153e.jpg

Igor benefits from a stacking rage affect that increases damage output for a short duration after destroying an enemy. Igor rewards a swift and aggressive playstyle (and may be a tad strong at the moment so give it a whirl before the balance-hammer comes knocking!)


Today, Numskull Games and I are hosting an AMA on the r/Games subreddit. We’d like to invite you all to join us if you have time to drop by! 

https://www.reddit.com/r/Games/comments/csi0nf/ama_i_am_lino_slahuschek_solo_developer_of_rogue/ 


Patch Notes
- Challenges implemented (Should sync with Steam achievements shortly)
- Character “Igor” added
- Balance changes to reduce unfair spikes in difficulty
- Enemy behaviour and properties tweaked
- Likelihood of especially hard rooms reduced
- Tweaked numerous items, most important changes:
    - "Corrupt Items" are more common now
    - "SpinningMace" damage increased
    - "IceCube" lower chance to freeze but higher freeze duration
    - "GoldenAmulet" reduced chance, reduced enemy golden-state duration
    - "Grenade" damage increased
    - "ExplosiveLove" explosion immunity applied to the whole team
    - "MissileBarrage" missile count increased
    - "DamageBoost" reduced damage

As always, we welcome you to contribute your feedback and suggestions on the Steam Discussion boards! I’d love to hear how you are getting on with Rogue Glitch and what areas you would like to see improved as a priority. I will pin two threads for community item and character ideas this week.

Many thanks and happy roguelite-ing!
-Lino
